Subject: Mutual Action Plan: POC environment setup (org keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Hi Jordan / Asha —

Thanks for the demo yesterday — excited to move to the POC. I attached a short MAP spreadsheet (MAP_MedNova_POCrev1.xlsx) that captures the milestones we discussed and owners for each step. Quick summary of the POC environment items we need to close in the next 10 business days:

- Org setup: create MedNova org in Redwood console and add 2 admin users (Asha, Jordan) — owner: Laura Bennett — ETA 2 business days
- API keys: one read/write POC key + one audit-only key for integrations — owner: Laura Bennett — ETA 2 business days after org creation
- IP allowlist: send CIDR ranges for staging and corp egress — owner: MedNova (Jordan) — we’ll provide expected ingress ports and example firewall entries
- VPC peering: schedule peering window (requires security pre-checks) — owner: Rishi Malhotra — target within 7 business days

Could you confirm the team that will be referenced for the org admin invites, and share the staging IP ranges? I’ve also listed a proposed peering maintenance window on the MAP (Friday 11/27 01:00-03:00 UTC) — we can move if that conflicts with your change freeze.

Attachments: MAP_MedNova_POCrev1.xlsx (MAP), poc_network_diagram.png (high-level peering diagram)

Next steps: if you confirm the staging CIDRs and admin emails by EOD Thu 11/19, we’ll schedule the peering pre-check and start org provisioning.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: POC environment setup (org keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and the CIDRs. Short answers and actions below: 

- Scoped API keys: yes. We can issue a scoped POC key limited to the evaluation model family and restrict generation endpoints; audit key will be read-only and restricted to metrics/usage endpoints. Laura will provision both keys and post the key IDs to the MAP.
- Org invites: Laura will send the console invites once the org record is created (I’ve created a placeholder in our system so it will be ready).
- IP allowlist: our ingress expects ports 443 and 8443 for the peering tunnel; we’ll provide firewall sample rules. Please ensure NAT egress range 198.51.100.0/24 is reachable from your VPN/CDN path.
- VPC peering pre-checks: Rishi will run the checklist (sample: BGP config, route table verification, MTU) and coordinate the peering window. If everything is green he’ll request the 11/27 window.

Action owners & short timeline (included in updated MAP attached):
- Laura Bennett: org creation + keys (ETA 11/20 17:00 PST) — attachment: MAP_MedNova_POCrev1.xlsx
- Jordan Ellis (MedNova): confirm any additional staging ranges and approve peering window (ETA 11/19 EOD)
- Rishi Malhotra: peering pre-check and runbook (ETA initial check 11/23)

I’ve attached the updated MAP with owner cells filled. If you approve the flows I’ll ask Rishi to schedule the pre-check and book the maintenance window.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: POC environment setup (org keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Kim / Laura — quick internal update before I reach out to MedNova ops: 

- I validated the peering checklist against their provided CIDRs. Items to call out:
  * Route table: MedNova must add 10.14.32.0/22 -> peering-rt for staging.
  * MTU: default 1500 should be fine, but they have a VPN appliance that sometimes rewrites headers — will confirm.
  * Firewall: we only need 443 and 8443 open inbound to the peering endpoint.

- Timeline: I can complete the pre-check by Mon 11/23 14:00 PST and, if green, request the 11/27 01:00-03:00 UTC window. I’ll publish a short runbook link after the check.

- Notes on keys: after Laura issues scoped keys, I’ll add network-level controls to the POC endpoint so generation calls from non-allowlisted IPs are rejected with a clear error 403. That will let MedNova rotate keys safely during the POC.

I’ll loop in MedNova ops first thing Mon morning with a succinct checklist and the runbook link.

Thanks —
Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
